text:
Situation: Cefotetan has been on the FDA shortage list since 2014-08-14, a span of 146 months as of 2026-10-21. Current inventory across three sites provides 11 to 25 days on hand at present usage rates.

Why (FDA record): The FDA shortage posting for cefotetan dates to 2014-08-14. A registered plant on the Fresenius Kabi label, ACS Dobfar S.p.A. (FEI 3006028606), received an OAI classification after an inspection ending 2016-01-19, which was 523 days after the shortage posting. That plant had prior VAI inspections ending 2012-03-27, 2014-03-18, and 2014-05-23, with the last two occurring 149 and 83 days before the shortage posting. A Warning Letter was issued to the plant on 2017-01-13, and subsequent inspections through 2024-12-13 have been classified VAI.

Our position: Supply remains constrained. Two P&T-approved interchange options exist. Inventory levels require active management to avoid stockouts.

Recommended actions:
1. Activate the Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC product (NDC 63323038510) per the interchange authorized by Sam Rivera, MD on 2026-04-28. Approval required: pharmacist.
2. Activate the PAI Holdings, LLC dba PAI Pharma product (NDC 00121097610) per the interchange authorized by Riley Brooks, PharmD on 2026-04-11. Approval required: pharmacist.
3. Evaluate purchase from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., which is not on the FDA shortage list today. Approval required: buyer.

Not recommended: No additional actions at this time.
